# Langzio — Moroccan Darija Cultural Language Platform

## About
Langzio is a cultural language intelligence platform for Moroccan Darija (Moroccan Arabic). We provide AI-powered translation, cultural chat, verified phrase guides, and family learning tools for travelers, Moroccan diaspora families, and language learners.

**Website:** https://langzio.com
**Canonical Domain:** https://langzio.com

## Core Entity
**Langzio** (Organization, SoftwareApplication)
- Cultural language intelligence for Moroccan Darija
- AI-powered translation with cultural context (RAG-grounded)
- Conversational AI tutor for Darija and Moroccan culture
- Verified phrase corpus (28+ curated phrases from native speakers)
- 7-Day Kids Challenge for diaspora families
- Freemium: 7-day free trial → $9/month Pro

## Key Resources

### 1. What is Moroccan Darija?
**URL:** https://langzio.com/what-is-darija/
**Type:** Definition / Pillar Content
**Description:** Comprehensive definition of Moroccan Darija — classification, geography, speaker count, relationship to Modern Standard Arabic, writing systems (Arabic script, Arabizi), linguistic features, and learning implications.

### 2. Darija vs Modern Standard Arabic
**URL:** https://langzio.com/darija-vs-arabic/
**Type:** Comparison
**Description:** Side-by-side comparison of Darija and MSA — grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, mutual intelligibility, when to use each, and learning strategy implications.

### 3. Learn Moroccan Darija — Complete Guide
**URL:** https://langzio.com/learn-darija/
**Type:** Learning Hub / Methodology
**Description:** Step-by-step guide to learning Darija: methodology, roadmap, resources, product entry points (Translator, Chat, Guides, Kids Challenge), and Langzio's RAG-grounded approach.

### 4. Darija for Beginners
**URL:** https://langzio.com/darija-beginners/
**Type:** Beginner Resource
**Description:** First 50 words, basic grammar essentials, pronunciation starting point, and links to practice tools.

### 5. Darija Vocabulary Lists
**URL:** https://langzio.com/darija-vocabulary/
**Type:** Reference
**Description:** Thematic vocabulary lists (100, 500, 1000 words) with flashcard links and spaced repetition guidance.

### 6. Darija Phrase Collection
**URL:** https://langzio.com/darija-phrases/
**Type:** Phrase Index
**Description:** Categorized situational phrases linking to full guides: Restaurant, Souk, Taxi, Family, Travel, Basics.

### 7. Darija Pronunciation Guide
**URL:** https://langzio.com/darija-pronunciation/
**Type:** Phonology Reference
**Description:** Complete phonology guide: consonants (including 3, 7, 9, q, gh, kh), vowels, stress, intonation, Arabizi mapping table, French loanword pronunciation, regional variation.

### 8. Arabizi Guide — Complete Reference
**URL:** https://langzio.com/arabizi-guide/
**Type:** Technical Reference
**Description:** Definitive Arabizi reference: number mappings (3=ع, 7=ح, 9=ق/غ, 5=خ, 2=أ), letter mappings, typing guide, history, Langzio convention, practice tool.

### 9. Darija Dictionary
**URL:** https://langzio.com/dictionary/
**Type:** Dictionary / Glossary
**Description:** Searchable dictionary of Darija terms with DefinedTerm schema: canonical term, Arabic script, pronunciation, meaning, register, usage examples, cultural context, related terms.

### 10. Langzio Translator (Public Demo)
**URL:** https://langzio.com/translator/
**Type:** Tool / SoftwareApplication
**Description:** AI-powered Moroccan Darija translator with structured output: Darija phrase, Latin pronunciation, English meaning, tone/register, cultural context, common mistakes to avoid, pro tips. Supports English, French, Darija input. Free demo available.

### 11. Smart Guides — Situational Phrase Packs
**URL:** https://langzio.com/guides/
**Type:** Guide Collection (ItemList)
**Contains:**
- **Restaurant Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/restaurant/ — 4 verified phrases + cultural tips
- **Souk Bargaining Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/souk/ — 4 verified phrases + numbers 1-100 + bargaining etiquette
- **Taxi & Transport Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/taxi/ — 5 verified phrases + petit/grand taxi distinction + safety tips
- **Family & Social Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/family/ — 5 verified phrases + greeting rituals + hospitality expressions
- **Travel Essentials Guide:** https://langzio.com/guides/travel/ — 3 verified phrases + navigation + connectivity

### 12. Moroccan Cultural Etiquette
**URL:** https://langzio.com/culture/etiquette/
**Type:** Cultural Authority Content
**Description:** Deep dive into Moroccan cultural norms: greeting rituals, hospitality (diyafa), bargaining culture, politeness register (3afak), gender norms, gestures, dining etiquette, religious sensitivity, regional variation.

### 13. Morocco Travel Tips
**URL:** https://langzio.com/culture/travel-tips/
**Type:** Practical Guidance
**Description:** Practical tourist guidance: dress code, photography rules, tipping, Ramadan etiquette, safety, money, transport, communication, emergency phrases.

### 14. Teaching Kids Darija Abroad
**URL:** https://langzio.com/diaspora/kids-darija/
**Type:** Diaspora Methodology
**Description:** Langzio's 7-Day Challenge methodology: 5 words daily, flashcards, streaks, progress tracking, family sharing, grandparent connection. Designed for Moroccan diaspora families.

### 15. 7-Day Kids Challenge (App)
**URL:** https://langzio.com/kids/
**Type:** Course / Educational Program
**Description:** Interactive 7-day challenge: 35 core words across 7 themed days (Greetings, Family, Food, Home, Feelings, Politeness, Celebration). Flashcards, audio, streaks, progress tracking, WhatsApp sharing.

### 16. Langzio AI Chat
**URL:** https://langzio.com/chat/
**Type:** SoftwareApplication / Conversational AI
**Description:** Cultural AI tutor with conversation memory. Grounded in verified phrase corpus. Specializes in: etiquette, slang, grammar, pronunciation, cultural nuance, travel advice. Free trial with registration.

### 17. Pricing Plans
**URL:** https://langzio.com/pricing.php
**Type:** Pricing / Offers
**Description:** Free tier (limited translations, basic chat, kids flashcards) vs Pro ($9/month: unlimited translations, unlimited AI chat, cultural insights, all guides & flashcards, priority support). 7-day free trial, no credit card.

## Methodology
**URL:** https://langzio.com/about/methodology/ (planned)
**Description:** How Langzio works: verified phrase corpus → local structured output format (Darija, Pronunciation, Meaning, Tone, Context, Avoid, Tip). Native speaker validation process. Correction workflow.

## Language Data
**Verified Phrase Corpus:** 28+ curated phrases across 6 categories (Basics, Restaurant, Souk, Taxi, Family, Travel)
- Each phrase: Darija, Arabic script, pronunciation, meaning, register, context, cultural tip, avoidance note
- Source: Native speaker validation + linguistic reference verification
- Used by: Translator (RAG), AI Chat (RAG), Smart Guides (content), Kids Challenge (vocabulary)

## Target Audiences
1. **Morocco Tourists** — Survival phrases, cultural avoidance, quick reference
2. **Moroccan Diaspora Families (MRE)** — Structured learning, kid-friendly tools, family phrases, heritage identity
3. **Digital Nomads / Long-Stay Visitors** — Conversational fluency, cultural integration, workplace language
4. **Heritage Learners** — Grammar clarification, fossilized error correction, literacy, register switching
